lines.en: label trinity3:
scene concerned1
Let me tell you a story.
lines.zh: 让我给你讲个故事。

lines.en: Before there was something, there was nothing.
lines.zh: 在有「某物」之前，什么都没有。

lines.en: The end.
lines.zh: 剧终。

lines.en: Still here?
lines.zh: 还在吗？

lines.en: Then I SUPPOSE I iweiprfifgwipdghofgerhfghjfgsdg.
lines.zh: 那么我想我就 iweiprfifgwipdghofgerhfghjfgsdg。

lines.en: A hand smacks against the keyboard inside of my brain out of pure concern for my well being.
lines.zh: 一只手出于对我身心健康的纯粹关切，拍在了我脑子里的键盘上。

lines.en: A child hovers above an unfamiliar teaching podium and smiles at me.
lines.zh: 一个孩子悬在一个陌生的讲台上方，对我微笑。

lines.en: I remember that there is no god.
lines.zh: 我想起来了，没有神。

lines.en: And then I remember many things about when I was young.
lines.zh: 然后我想起了许多关于我小时候的事。

lines.en: They all flood back at once.
lines.zh: 它们一下子全都涌了回来。

lines.en: The eyes of old family members who have since passed away due to undiscovered illnesses (Or car accidents) leak into my mind.
lines.zh: 那些早已因未被发现的疾病（或车祸）离世的家族长辈的眼睛，渗进了我的脑海。

lines.en: I can almost taste them.
lines.zh: 我几乎能尝到它们的味道。

lines.en: I can taste their eyes.
lines.zh: 我能尝到他们的眼睛。

lines.en: I can taste parts of them I never expected to taste.
lines.zh: 我能尝到我从没想过会尝到的部位。

lines.en: It’s all so delicious.
lines.zh: 一切都如此美味。

lines.en: scene concerned2
A small version of Maya in her Halloween costume appears and the baby begins to cry tears of blood. Oh no!
lines.zh: 一个穿着万圣节服装的小号 Maya 出现了，婴儿开始哭出血泪。不好了！

lines.en: {i}*Meanwhile in Kumon-mi, the reincarnation (?) of an older male violently fucks his students in their respective dorm rooms*{/i}
lines.zh: {i}*与此同时在 Kumon-mi，一位年长男性的转世（？）正在各自的宿舍里粗暴地操他的学生们*{/i}

lines.en: And so you’re likely to ask, what’s happening? Why are we here?
lines.zh: 所以你大概会问：发生了什么？我们为什么在这里？

lines.en: And the answer to that is simple!
lines.zh: 而答案很简单！

lines.en: But I have no reason to tell you for the next several years!
lines.zh: 但在接下来的几年里，我都没有理由告诉你！

lines.en: The foundation’s all laid out.
lines.zh: 地基已经全部铺好了。

lines.en: So let’s summarize what we know, shall we?
lines.zh: 那么我们来总结一下已知的东西吧，好吗？

lines.en: The world was made by a horny ball of light named Nozomu who got tired of living in perpetual loneliness and created humanity in order to satiate his lust.
lines.zh: 世界是由一个名叫 Nozomu 的饥渴光球创造的，它厌倦了永远孤独地活着，于是创造了人类来满足自己的欲望。

lines.en: Nozomu is dead now.
lines.zh: Nozomu 现在死了。

lines.en: Kind of.
lines.zh: 算是吧。

lines.en: That part’s a little more complicated than you might think- which is probably already really fucking complicated to begin with. Lol.
lines.zh: 那部分比你想象的还要复杂一点——而你想的可能本来就已经他妈的够复杂了。哈哈。

lines.en: Okay, so what’s next?
lines.zh: 好吧，那接下来呢？

lines.en: Oh, right. Maya.
lines.zh: 哦，对。Maya。

lines.en: Yeah, you probably think she’s some kind of mastermind or linked to the underlying secrets of what’s going on here, right?
lines.zh: 是啊，你大概以为她是什么幕后主使，或者和眼下这些事的底层秘密有关，对吧？

lines.en: Lol. Okay.
lines.zh: 哈哈。行吧。

lines.en: scene concerned3
Look at this fucking face.
lines.zh: 看看这张该死的脸。

lines.en: She’s completely normal.
lines.zh: 她完全就是个普通人。

lines.en: Why do you think she knows so much, huh?
lines.zh: 你为什么觉得她知道那么多，嗯？

lines.en: Because she can reset the world?
lines.zh: 因为她能重置世界？

lines.en: We can all reset the world.
lines.zh: 我们所有人都能重置世界。

lines.en: All we need to do is jump.
lines.zh: 我们要做的只是跳下去。

lines.en: I told you that in the beginning.
lines.zh: 我在开头就告诉过你了。

lines.en: And no, that isn’t an endorsement of suicide or any of that bullshit. (I’m legally obligated to say this in order to deny responsibility.)
lines.zh: 不，那可不是在鼓励自杀或什么的废话。（我法律上有义务这么说，好撇清责任。）

lines.en: But what I’m saying is that NONE OF IT FUCKING MATTERS.
lines.zh: 但我想说的是：这一切都他妈的毫无意义。

lines.en: Nothing is real. Nothing is real. NOTHING IS REAL.
lines.zh: 没有什么是真的。没有什么是真的。什么都不是真的。

lines.en: LOOK INTO HER FUCKING EYES.
lines.zh: 给我好好看进她那双该死的眼睛。

lines.en: What do you see?
lines.zh: 你看到了什么？

lines.en: Are those really the eyes of a GOD?
lines.zh: 那真的是神的眼睛吗？

lines.en: God has so many more eyes.
lines.zh: 神的眼睛可比这多得多。

lines.en: Well, one god at least.
lines.zh: 嗯，至少有一位神是。

lines.en: Another one doesn’t have any eyes at all.
lines.zh: 另一位则一只眼睛都没有。

lines.en: Probably because the first fucking GOD kept them all to itself.
lines.zh: 大概是因为第一位该死的神把眼睛全都据为己有了。

lines.en: But it’s cool, dude. The second GOD makes up for the lack of EYES in WIRES!
lines.zh: 不过没关系，老兄。第二位神用「电线」弥补了没有「眼睛」的缺憾！

lines.en: scene concerned4
For those of you who don’t know what wires look like, they’re kind of like this but- Well, actually. They’re just like this.
lines.zh: 给不知道电线长什么样的各位科普一下：它们大概就像这样，不过——嗯，其实。它们就是这样。

lines.en: I just felt the need to throw in a happier picture because this is a “happy” scene after all.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得有必要插一张更开心的图，毕竟这可是一幕「欢乐」的场景。

lines.en: But even though it’s so happy there are still people who think it’s okay to skip past it!
lines.zh: 可尽管它这么欢乐，还是有人觉得跳过它也没关系！

lines.en: And boy oh boy am I here to tell you that’s a fucking JOKE.
lines.zh: 而老天啊，我就是来告诉你：那他妈是个笑话。

lines.en: So for you, human being who has taken the time out of their reasonably packed masturbation-schedule to read my words, I give you a reward!
lines.zh: 所以，对于你——从排得满满当当的自慰日程里挤出时间来读我这些话的人类——我要给你一份奖励！

lines.en: Write this down and do not share it with anyone else as it will be required in the near future.
lines.zh: 把它记下来，不要告诉任何人，因为不久的将来会用到它。

lines.en: Oh, and I obviously can’t {i}prevent{/i} you from sharing it, but know that if you DO you’re a fucking CUCK.
lines.zh: 哦，我显然没法{i}阻止{/i}你分享出去，但你要知道，如果你真那么做了，你就是个该死的绿帽奴。

lines.en: The IP address you will need when prompted is: 2342:5b7:489:de26:c666:x994:3126:b067
Hopefully your cooperation in NOT SHARING THIS will be enough to teach people to FACE THEIR FEARS.
lines.zh: 希望你在「不分享这个」上的配合，足以教会人们去直面自己的恐惧。

lines.en: These scenes aren’t even scary!
lines.zh: 这些场景根本一点都不可怕！

lines.en: scene concerned5
WHAT IS THERE TO BE AFRAID OF? THEY’RE JUST LINES!
lines.zh: 有什么好怕的？不过是几行字而已！

lines.en: What’s REALLY scary is that within the next year, someone you love is going to die.
lines.zh: 真正可怕的是，在未来一年之内，你爱的某个人将会死去。

lines.en: Fear that! Not this game!
lines.zh: 去怕那个吧！别怕这个游戏！

lines.en: Oh, wait.
lines.zh: 哦，等等。

lines.en: Right.
lines.zh: 对了。

lines.en: This isn’t a game at all.
lines.zh: 这根本就不是游戏。

lines.en: You’ve heard that from someone before, haven’t you?
lines.zh: 这句话你以前从谁那儿听过吧？

lines.en: TELL ‘EM AGAIN, MAYA!!!!
lines.zh: 再跟他们说一遍，MAYA！！！！

lines.en: scene concerned6
: This isn’t a game.
lines.zh: : 这不是游戏。

lines.en: : If it’s not a game then what’s with all of these references to simulations and all of that “USER2” stuff?
lines.zh: : 如果不是游戏，那这些关于模拟的说法、还有那些「USER2」的东西是怎么回事？

lines.en: : How would I know? I’m just a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道？我只是个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : It’s very possible that none of this is even happening right now.
lines.zh: : 很有可能这一切现在根本没有发生。

lines.en: : Have you ever considered that?
lines.zh: : 你有没有考虑过这种可能？

lines.en: : But if {i}this{/i} isn’t happening then what’s happening back in that place that we live in?
lines.zh: : 可如果{i}这里{/i}的事没有发生，那我们住的那个地方正在发生什么？

lines.en: : You mean Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你是说 Kumon-mi？

lines.en: : Yeah, that one.
lines.zh: : 对，就是那儿。

lines.en: : I guess you’ll find out when you wake up, won’t you?
lines.zh: : 我想你醒来之后就会知道了，不是吗？

lines.en: : So this is a dream?
lines.zh: : 所以这是一场梦？

lines.en: : How would I know? I’m just a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道？我只是个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : {s}JESUS CHRIST{/s} Wow, you’re no help at all. Are you?
lines.zh: : {s}耶稣基督啊{/s} 哇，你一点忙都帮不上，对吧？

lines.en: : Nope.
scene concerned7
Maya decides to stab herself in the temple and poorly drawn computer-generated blood spills out of her because this is all just a computer game or something and definitely not anything else.
lines.zh: Maya 决定往自己的太阳穴上捅一刀，画得很烂的电脑生成血液从她身上涌了出来，因为这一切只是个电脑游戏什么的，绝对不是别的任何东西。

lines.en: So, while she bleeds out in front of us, let’s recap some other stuff we know.
lines.zh: 那么，趁她在我们面前流血至死，我们来回顾一下别的已知信息吧。

lines.en: Ami is your [niece] and her parents are dead.
lines.zh: Ami 是你的[niece]，她的父母已经死了。

lines.en: But what do we know about them?
lines.zh: 可我们对他们了解多少呢？

lines.en: Well, for one, her father was your brother.
lines.zh: 嗯，首先，她的父亲是你的哥哥。

lines.en: And I use the term {i}YOUR{/i} loosely since it’s a lot harder figuring out who you are in this day and age than it used to be.
lines.zh: 而且{i}你的{/i}这个词我用得很宽泛，因为在这个年头，要弄清你到底是谁比以前难多了。

lines.en: But yeah, that guy was related to you before he was turned into roadkill alongside his outrageously hot wife (The one who birthed the [niece] who [masturbate]s to you).
lines.zh: 不过没错，那家伙在和他那个辣到离谱的老婆（也就是生下那个对着你[masturbate]的[niece]的女人）一起变成路边肉泥之前，确实是你的亲人。

lines.en: You are Sensei! A totally normal guy with a totally normal sized penis.
lines.zh: 你是 Sensei！一个百分百正常的男人，有着百分百正常尺寸的阴茎。

lines.en: Everyone seems to like you for reasons beyond your comprehension.
lines.zh: 每个人都似乎喜欢你，理由超出你的理解范围。

lines.en: Probably because you’re the protagonist and that’s just how things would ideally work in a world you make for yourself, right?
lines.zh: 大概因为你是主角，而在你为自己创造的世界里，事情本来就该这么理想地运转，对吧？

lines.en: But what if someone else makes the world?
lines.zh: 可如果是别人创造了这个世界呢？

lines.en: Or, better yet, what if the world was a fruit that fell off of a tree?
lines.zh: 或者更好一点：如果这个世界是从树上掉下来的果子呢？

lines.en: scene concerned8
OR EVEN BETTER YET, what if it was GOD who made that tree and so all of the fruit that fell off of it was also kind of made by GOD in a really roundabout sort of way.
lines.zh: 或者还要更好一点：如果是神造了那棵树，那么从树上掉下来的所有果子，也算是拐着弯由神造的呢？

lines.en: And then so many people thought that GOD was awesome for making such a rad fruit and then they all started worshipping him and saying sex was bad or something like that.
lines.zh: 然后很多人觉得神造了这么棒的果子真是太厉害了，于是纷纷开始崇拜他，还说什么性是坏的之类的。

lines.en: You know how religions get, right?
lines.zh: 你知道宗教就是那副德性，对吧？

lines.en: So the REALLY RAD sex-world fruit that fell off of the GOD-TREE wasn’t ever really yours but his or hers.
lines.zh: 所以那颗从神之树上掉下来的、超棒的性爱世界之果，从来就不属于你，而是属于他或她。

lines.en: Oh, but we’ve gotta remember that GOD is THREE gods and that they all joined forces to plant the seed that made your cool new sex-world.
lines.zh: 哦，不过我们得记住，神是三位神，他们联手种下了那颗种子，才有了你那个酷炫的新性爱世界。

lines.en: Religion’s fucking complicated, yo.
lines.zh: 宗教真他妈复杂，哟。

lines.en: So, there you are in fruit-land, surrounded by a bunch of [teenager]s who can all miraculously fit your {s}HUGE{/s} normal sized dick in them and you’re concerned with how they feel.
lines.zh: 于是你就站在果子之地，被一群[teenager]包围着，她们全都奇迹般地容得下你那根{s}巨大{/s}正常尺寸的鸡巴，而你却在担心她们的感受。

lines.en: In fact, right now you’re probably thinking of which one of them you’re going to level next or some shit.
lines.zh: 事实上，你现在大概正在想，接下来要攻略她们中的哪一个之类的。

lines.en: But when was the last time you stopped and thought about what happens when their stories come to an end?
lines.zh: 可你上一次停下来想过——当她们的故事走到尽头时会发生什么——是什么时候？

lines.en: If everyone’s story comes to an end at once, that means your story comes to an end, too. Right?
lines.zh: 如果所有人的故事同时结束，那就意味着你的故事也结束了。对吧？

lines.en: scene concerned9
: Wrong.
: Your story will go on because you’re meant to fix this world!
lines.zh: : 你的故事会继续下去，因为你是注定要修复这个世界的人！

lines.en: : You’re the only one who can truly kill God!
lines.zh: : 你是唯一真正能杀死神的人！

lines.en: : And you must listen to me because I am an unnamed baby!
lines.zh: : 而且你必须听我的，因为我是一个无名的婴儿！

lines.en: : Okay, this is just getting way too complicated now.
lines.zh: : 好了，这现在变得太复杂了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry! This is the only time I will ever show up!
lines.zh: : 别担心！我只会出现这一次！

lines.en: : I’m unimportant and was stillborn anyway, so you can just completely disregard my existence and focus on everyone you already know instead.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不重要，而且本来就是死胎，所以你完全可以无视我的存在，专心去关注你已经认识的那些人。

lines.en: : I’d love to but Maya stabbed herself in the head a few minutes ago and I’m worried I’ll never see her again.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊，可 Maya 几分钟前捅了自己的头，我担心再也见不到她了。

lines.en: : Worried? About Maya? After all of the disdain she’s shown you?
lines.zh: : 担心？担心 Maya？在她对你表现出那么多轻蔑之后？

lines.en: : How do you know about that, Unnamed Baby?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道这些，无名婴儿？

lines.en: : One of the three gods filled me in before this scene, so I’ve got a pretty solid grip on everything.
lines.zh: : 在这一幕之前，三位神中的一位给我补了课，所以我对一切都掌握得挺牢的。

lines.en: : I’m so confused.
lines.zh: : 我好混乱。

lines.en: : I’d be confused too. This story isn’t exactly easy to follow, is it?
lines.zh: : 我也会混乱。这个故事确实不太好跟，是吧？

lines.en: : In fact, I didn’t even plan on taking this job but there just aren’t a lot of openings for stillborn children, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我本来也没打算接这份工作，只是很遗憾，死胎的岗位真的不多。

lines.en: : Such a shame. You’re doing great.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。你做得很好。

lines.en: : I’d say you have your whole life ahead of you but yeah.
lines.zh: : 我本想说你还有大好人生在前面，不过嘛。

lines.en: : Oof. Uncool, man.
lines.zh: : 呃。你这话就不厚道了，老兄。

lines.en: : So what now?
lines.zh: : 那么现在怎么办？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : Where do I go?
lines.zh: : 我该去哪儿？

lines.en: : How do I get out of here and what was even the point of this...dream?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么离开这里？还有这场……梦的意义到底是什么？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃。

lines.en: : Idk, let me ask my boss.
lines.zh: : 不知道，我问问我的老板吧。

lines.en: scene concerned10
show hope
: WE MEET AGAIN
lines.zh: : 我们又见面了

lines.en: A horrifying image appears before me and suddenly the narration switches back to my perspective.
lines.zh: 一个可怖的影像出现在我面前，突然间，叙述切换回了我的视角。

lines.en: I wonder who was speaking before?
lines.zh: 我很好奇刚才说话的是谁？

lines.en: : How do I get home?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么回家？

lines.en: : YOU DONT
lines.zh: : 你回不去

lines.en: : YOU STAY HERE FOREVER
lines.zh: : 你永远留在这儿

lines.en: : Is Maya really dead?
lines.zh: : Maya 真的死了吗？

lines.en: : WAS SHE EVER ALIVE?????
lines.zh: : 她真的活过吗？？？？？

lines.en: : Yeah, I see her every day in[school].
lines.zh: : 啊，我每天在[school]都能看见她。

lines.en: : IS SIMPLY SEEING ENOUGH TO CONFIRM THE EXISTENCE OF ANYTHING????
lines.zh: : 光是「看见」，就足以确认任何东西的存在吗？？？？

lines.en: : Not exactly but when everyone else is associating with her as well it kind of drops a few hints that she is a living human being.
lines.zh: : 不完全是，不过当其他人也都在和她来往时，多少暗示了她是个活生生的人。

lines.en: : YOU ARE PERCEPTIVE
lines.zh: : 你很敏锐

lines.en: : Just common observational skills, really.
lines.zh: : 只不过是普通的观察力罢了。

lines.en: : THE GIRL DOES LIVE
lines.zh: : 那个女孩确实活着

lines.en: : SHE HAS LIVED MORE LIVES THAN YOU COULD POSSIBLY IMAGINE
lines.zh: : 她活过的次数，远超你的想象

lines.en: : And I’m assuming you’re in the same boat, strange celestial figure?
lines.zh: : 那我猜你也是一样吧，奇怪的天界存在？

lines.en: : I HAVE ONLY LIVED ONE LIFE BUT IT HAS BEEN AND WILL BE AN ETERNAL ONE
lines.zh: : 我只活过一次，但那一次既已是永恒，也将是永恒

lines.en: : I AM THE THING WITH FEATHERS
lines.zh: : 我是那长着羽毛的东西

lines.en: : I AM THE SOUND OF THE CICADAS
lines.zh: : 我是蝉鸣之声

lines.en: : I AM THE WIND THAT BREAKS BRANCHES OFF OF NEARBY TREES AND TOSSES THEM ONTO YOUR HOUSE LIKE DISCARDED CONDOMS
lines.zh: : 我是那阵折断附近树枝、把它们像用过的避孕套一样甩到你屋顶上的风

lines.en: : I AM THE HOPE INSIDE OF YOUR HEART
lines.zh: : 我是你心中的希望

lines.en: : And you are nothing.
lines.zh: : 而你什么都不是。

lines.en: : You will always be nothing.
lines.zh: : 你永远都将什么都不是。

lines.en: : So why not live for something greater?
lines.zh: : 那何不为更伟大的东西而活？

lines.en: : Why not live for me?
lines.zh: : 何不为我而活？

lines.en: : That sounds like something a god would say.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来像是神会说的。

lines.en: : It does, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是吧，不是吗？

lines.en: : Do you think it’s a coincidence?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这是巧合吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know what to think. My head kind of hurts after everything I’ve seen over the last few minutes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该想什么。刚才这几分钟看到的一切，让我头有点疼。

lines.en: : That’s just the pressure of the entire world lying directly above you.
lines.zh: : 那只是整个世界正压在你头顶的重量。

lines.en: : Down here, only those I believe in can open their eyes.
lines.zh: : 在这下面，只有我所信之人才能睁开眼睛。

lines.en: : This is the bottom of everything.
lines.zh: : 这里是一切的底部。

lines.en: : Where time is infinite.
lines.zh: : 时间是无限的。

lines.en: : You may sleep here.
lines.zh: : 你可以在这里安睡。

lines.en: : You may have your way with anyone you so desire.
lines.zh: : 你可以随心所欲地和任何你想要的人在一起。

lines.en: : All I ask is that you surrender both yourself and them to me.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的请求，就是你把自己、以及她们，都交给我。

lines.en: I go to speak but accidentally swallow my tongue.
lines.zh: 我想要说话，却不小心把自己的舌头吞了下去。

lines.en: That isn’t a figure of speech. I literally swallow my tongue.
lines.zh: 这不是比喻。我是字面意义上把自己的舌头吞了下去。

lines.en: It gets stuck in my throat on the way down and it becomes impossible to breathe.
lines.zh: 它在下滑的路上卡在我的喉咙里，让我无法呼吸。

lines.en: But the familiar feeling of an invisible arm passing through me wraps its long, slender fingers around my lungs and begins to massage them.
lines.zh: 但那种熟悉的、无形的手臂穿过我的感觉出现了，它修长的手指缠上我的肺，开始按摩起来。

lines.en: I breathe through the hand of a false god.
lines.zh: 我借着一位伪神的手呼吸。

lines.en: Or a true god.
lines.zh: 或者一位真神。

lines.en: God is dead.
lines.zh: 神已死。

lines.en: Or at least he’s supposed to be.
lines.zh: 或者至少他本该是死的。

lines.en: Or used to be.
lines.zh: 或者曾经是。

lines.en: : What are you thinking, human?
lines.zh: : 你在想什么，人类？

lines.en: : edfihgeirhgjwerfihgbdfbhefhurghwghidfw
lines.zh: : edfihgeirhgjwerfihgbdfbhefhurghwghidfw

lines.en: : You’re going to need to speak up.
lines.zh: : 你得说大声点。

lines.en: : edfihgeirhgjwerfihgbdfbhefhurghwghidfw!!!
lines.zh: : edfihgeirhgjwerfihgbdfbhefhurghwghidfw!!!

lines.en: Despite being able to breathe now, I still lack a tongue.
lines.zh: 尽管现在能呼吸了，我还是没有舌头。

lines.en: My words go unrecognized, and for good reason.
lines.zh: 我的话没人听得懂，而且理由充分。

lines.en: They mean nothing.
lines.zh: 它们什么也不表示。

lines.en: scene black
Everything means nothing and nothing means everything.
lines.zh: 一切意味着虚无，而虚无意味着一切。

lines.en: The world fades to black as I begin to lose hope.
lines.zh: 随着我开始失去希望，世界渐渐褪成黑色。

lines.en: I become unable to raise my head.
lines.zh: 我连头都抬不起来了。

lines.en: : THIS WILL BE OUR LAST MEETING FOR QUITE SOME TIME
lines.zh: : 这将是我们很长一段时间内的最后一次会面

lines.en: : I HAVE MORE IMPORTANT MATTERS TO ATTEND TO
lines.zh: : 我有更重要的事要处理

lines.en: Something about the strange, powerful voice that makes no sound but booms inside of my head tells me that the creature’s errands involve a plethora of wires.
lines.zh: 那个奇怪而威严的声音无声无息，却在我的脑海里轰鸣；它让我觉得，这个生物要去办的事和大量的电线有关。

lines.en: I think about how it would feel to have those wires wrapped around my neck.
lines.zh: 我想象着那些电线缠在我脖子上会是什么感觉。

lines.en: How it would feel to suffocate for real instead of suffocating inside of a dream.
lines.zh: 想象着真正窒息的感觉，而不是在梦里窒息。

lines.en: It is times like these that I wish I could love.
lines.zh: 正是这样的时刻，我希望自己能够去爱。

lines.en: Maybe one day, if I try hard enough, I will be able to.
lines.zh: 也许有一天，只要我足够努力，我就能做到。
